# Validation results (generated by scripts/run_validation.py)

## V1 Engine fidelity

- WCS engine reproduces **249 of 249** GeoVision workbooks to the dollar (max error $3.73e-09).
- NREL 2025 parameters on the 5,000 m vertical well: -15.4 % (NREL reports about -15 %).

## V2 Structure test (anchored on Cape well 1, same learning curve)

| Time-driven share | Cost change, well 6 vs 1 | MAPE wells 2-6 |
|---|---|---|
| 21% | -5 % | 52 % |
| 40% | -12 % | 42 % |
| 60% | -19 % | 31 % |
| 75% | -25 % | 23 % |
| 86% | -29 % | 17 % |
| 100% | -34 % | 9 % |

Observed change, well 6 vs 1: -42 %.

## V3 In-sample fit (6 Cape wells)

- WCS-L: MAPE cost 4.5 %, MAPE days 3.4 %; P10-P90 band contains 83 % of costs and 100 % of days.
- WCS (NREL 2025): MAPE cost 20.0 %. WCS split + learning anchored on well 1: 43.1 %.

## V4 Out-of-sample forecasts

| Model | One-step-ahead MAPE, cost (wells 4-6) | Bias | MAPE, days | Hold-out 1-4 -> 5-6 MAPE, cost | Bias |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| WCS-L | 10.6 % | -0.0 % | 10.8 % | 13.5 % | -13.5 % |
| Fervo split + learning (1-line model) | 14.5 % | 13.1 % | 10.0 % | 3.8 % | 1.7 % |
| Persistence (last well, per ft) | 12.2 % | 4.1 % | 11.3 % | 7.6 % | -7.6 % |

## V5 Probabilistic calibration (WCS-L, pooled out-of-sample forecasts)

- 5 forecasts; P10-P90 band contains 100 % of observed costs and 100 % of observed days (nominal 80 %).
- CRPS (cost, one-step-ahead): $0.33M for WCS-L vs mean absolute error $0.69M (Fervo split + learning (1-line model)), $0.61M (Persistence (last well, per ft)), $0.48M (WCS, NREL 2025 parameters), $1.24M (WCS split + learning (1-line model)).
- PIT values (cost): 0.14, 0.89, 0.36, 0.88, 0.78.

## V6 Cross-project transfer (Project Red -> Cape)

- Red wells: 6.33 and 5.17 days per 1,000 ft; first Cape well 2.53.
- With a one-year gap and experience from another project at half weight, E = 1.42: learning alone predicts the first Cape well at 86 % of Red-1; observed 40 %.
- The remaining factor (0.47) is a technology, design or geology step: a lower floor (generation_floor), not learning.

## V7 Activity check (Utah FORGE 16A)

| Activity | FORGE 16A share of rig hours | WCS share of hours |
|---|---|---|
| drilling | 18 % | 44 % |
| tripping | 29 % | 20 % |
| casing_cementing | 4 % | 9 % |
| logging | 3 % | 11 % |
| flat | 44 % | 15 % |

- Flat time missing from the WCS: 29 % of rig hours, which implies a time scale of about 1.41; the calibrated time scale at Cape is 1.62.
